[Back to all emotions](index.qmd)

Guilt can help us notice when our behaviour does not match our values.

## It can give us the urge to

- apologize;
- repair; or
- make amends.

## It may be telling us

- our behaviour may not match our values;
- someone may have been hurt; or
- a correction may be needed.

## What can help

1. Check the facts.
2. Acknowledge what happened.
3. Repair the harm.
4. Change the behaviour, then let go.

## Design connection

Natural imagery, grounded type, and reuse symbols can communicate responsibility and repair.

**Examples:** Patagonia, Depop, and thredUP.
